---
description: Perform a read-only security review of a feature, diff, or repository area.
---
Perform a read-only security review of the requested Bastak School scope. Inspect the actual trust boundaries and relevant auth, server capabilities, active organization scope, `/me/context` switches, validation, injection, browser, file, secret, dependency, PWA, hostname/CORS, and infrastructure risks. Preserve `/api/v2` and do not treat product branding or UI gating as an authority boundary. Rank only evidence-backed findings by realistic impact/exploitability, distinguish source findings from live-environment proof, and provide concrete remediation.
